  let empty = @ours.Variables::from_entries([("x", @ours.List([]))]).unwrap()
  let ours_t = @ours.parse("{?x}").unwrap()
  println("ours.empty_omitted=" + ours_t.check_bindings(empty).omitted.length().to_string())
  println("ours.required_empty=" + ours_t.expand_checked(empty, required=["x"]).unwrap_err().code)
  let jsj_t = @jsj.parse("{?x}").unwrap()
  println("jsj.empty_issues=" + jsj_t.inspect_bindings([("x", @jsj.List([]))]).issues().length().to_string())
  match jsj_t.expand_required([("x", @jsj.List([]))]) {
    Ok(s) => println("jsj.required_empty=accepted:" + s)
    Err(e) => println("jsj.required_empty=" + e.code())
  }
  let budget_vars = @ours.Variables::from_entries([("x", @ours.Scalar("😀"))]).unwrap()
  println("ours.output_budget=" + @ours.parse("{x}").unwrap().expand_with_limits(budget_vars, @ours.ExpansionLimits::new(max_output_bytes=11)).unwrap_err().code)
  try {
    let _ = @magic.UriTemplate::parse("{x}").expand_with_limit(Map([("x", @magic.Scalar("😀"))]), max_output_length=11)
    println("magic.output_budget=unexpected_success")
  } catch { e => println("magic.output_budget=" + e.to_string()) }
  println("jsj.output_budget=" + @jsj.parse("{x}").unwrap().expand([("x", @jsj.Scalar("😀"))], max_output=11).unwrap_err().code())

  let map_ours = @ours.Variables::from_entries([("x", @ours.Scalar("a")), ("y", @ours.Scalar("b"))]).unwrap()
  let map_jsj = [("x", @jsj.Scalar("a")), ("y", @jsj.Scalar("b"))]
  let ot = @ours.parse("{?x,y}").unwrap()
  let jt = @jsj.parse("{?x,y}").unwrap()
  println("ours.measure=" + ot.measure(map_ours).unwrap().to_string())
  println("jsj.measure=" + jt.measure(map_jsj).unwrap().to_string())
  println("ours.origins=" + ot.expand_mapped(map_ours).unwrap().origins.length().to_string())
  println("jsj.origins=" + jt.expand_detailed(map_jsj).unwrap().spans().length().to_string())
  println("ours.batch=" + ot.expand_batch([map_ours, map_ours]).unwrap().length().to_string())
  println("jsj.batch=" + jt.expand_many([map_jsj, map_jsj]).unwrap().length().to_string())
  let selective_ours = @ours.Variables::from_entries([("id", @ours.Scalar("42"))]).unwrap()
  println("ours.selective_required=" + @ours.parse("/users/{id}{?page}").unwrap().expand_checked(selective_ours, required=["id"]).unwrap())
  match @jsj.parse("/users/{id}{?page}").unwrap().expand_required([("id", @jsj.Scalar("42"))]) {
    Ok(s) => println("jsj.selective_required=" + s)
    Err(e) => println("jsj.selective_required=" + e.code())
  }
  let op = @ours.parse("{x:2}{+x}{?tags*}").unwrap().variable_profiles()[0]
  let jp = @jsj.parse("{x:2}{+x}{?tags*}").unwrap().variable_profiles()[0]
  println("ours.profile=" + op.occurrences.to_string() + "," + op.scalar_only.to_string() + "," + op.uses_reserved.to_string())
  println("jsj.profile=" + jp.occurrences.to_string() + "," + jp.scalar_only.to_string() + "," + jp.uses_reserved.to_string())
  let prefix_before = @ours.parse("{x:2}").unwrap()
  let prefix_after = @ours.parse("{x:3}").unwrap()
  let prefix_vars = @ours.Variables::from_entries([("x", @ours.Scalar("abcd"))]).unwrap()
  println("ours.prefix_change=" + prefix_before.diff_contract(prefix_after).variable_changes[0].prefixes_changed.to_string())
  println("ours.prefix_outputs=" + prefix_before.expand(prefix_vars).unwrap() + "," + prefix_after.expand(prefix_vars).unwrap())
  let jp_before = @jsj.parse("{x:2}").unwrap()
  let jp_after = @jsj.parse("{x:3}").unwrap()
  println("jsj.prefix_flag=" + jp_before.diff_contract(jp_after).has_flagged_changes().to_string())
  println("jsj.prefix_outputs=" + jp_before.expand([("x", @jsj.Scalar("abcd"))]).unwrap() + "," + jp_after.expand([("x", @jsj.Scalar("abcd"))]).unwrap())

  let typed_ours = @ours.parse("/users/{id}{?tags*}").unwrap().with_contract(
    [{name:"id",kind:@ours.ScalarKind},{name:"tags",kind:@ours.ListKind}], required=["id"],
  ).unwrap()
  let typed_jsj = @jsj.parse("/users/{id}{?tags*}").unwrap().with_contract(
    [{name:"id",kind:@jsj.TextValue,required:true},{name:"tags",kind:@jsj.ListValue,required:false}],
  ).unwrap()
  println("ours.typed_selective=" + typed_ours.expand(@ours.Variables::from_entries([("id",@ours.Scalar("42"))]).unwrap()).unwrap())
  println("jsj.typed_selective=" + typed_jsj.expand([("id",@jsj.Scalar("42"))]).unwrap())
  println("ours.typed_empty_wrong=" + (typed_ours.validate(@ours.Variables::from_entries([("id",@ours.List([]))]).unwrap()) is Err(_)).to_string())
  println("jsj.typed_empty_wrong=" + (typed_jsj.validate([("id",@jsj.List([]))]) is Err(_)).to_string())
  let links = @jsj.compile_catalog([("search","/search{?q}"),("health","/health")]).unwrap()
    .start_session([("q",@jsj.Scalar("old"))]).unwrap()
  let update = links.update([@jsj.SetBinding("q",@jsj.Scalar("new"))]).unwrap()
  println("jsj.incremental_recomputed=" + update.recomputed().to_string())
  println("jsj.incremental_old=" + links.links()[0].1)
  println("jsj.incremental_new=" + update.changes()[0].after)

  let ours_links = @ours.compile_catalog([("search","/search{?q}"),("health","/health")]).unwrap()
    .start_session(@ours.Variables::from_entries([("q",@ours.Scalar("old"))]).unwrap()).unwrap()
  let ours_update = ours_links.update([@ours.SetBinding("q",@ours.Scalar("new"))]).unwrap()
  println("ours.incremental_recomputed=" + ours_update.recomputed().to_string())
  println("ours.incremental_old=" + ours_links.get("search").unwrap())
  println("ours.incremental_new=" + ours_update.changes()[0].after)
